notes.title: Update 1 (Version 0.531)
notes.content:
Update 1 (Version 0.531)Nunchaku, Traffic Lights and Tesla Coils

New Unlockable Modifiers
-Traffic Light (Interactive Element)

-Nunchaku (Weapon)

-Tesla Coil (Interactive Element)


New Features
-Dropped Weapon are pickable

-Particles effects limited by FPS

-New Graphical Effects

-New Secondary Boomerang Attack

-All the weapon can activate Hives and Fire Trap


Bug Fixes (Main)
-No more than one weapon held

-No more no weapon

-Reduced the range of Dynamite

-Other minor bugs \[...]
